name: Alan Schermerhorn

nadir.desc: The property consists of a primary residence and multiple outbuildings clustered near the road, with a large open pasture extending across the majority of the lot|A small pond is visible in the open field|Scattered mature trees are present across the property|The site has a rural character with open grassland and secondary structures near the main house.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows the primary residence and several outbuildings located near the road|A driveway provides access to the cluster of structures|Open pasture land extends behind and to the side of the buildings, with scattered trees and a small pond visible in the field|The back line of the property is lined with a large bank of trees.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the cluster of buildings near the road, including the main residence and outbuildings|Large open pasture land extends across the majority of the lot, with scattered trees and a small pond|The terrain is open and rural in character.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property is dominated by large open pasture land with a small pond and scattered trees|The main residence and outbuildings are visible in the distance along the road|The open field provides extensive clear space across the back portion of the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows open pasture land with scattered trees and a small pond|The cluster of buildings, including the main residence and outbuildings, is visible near the road|The majority of the lot consists of open grassland typical of a rural setting.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a driveway leading from the street to the cluster of buildings along side of it. The main residence and multiple outbuildings are grouped together near the side of the property. Large open pasture areas provide extensive space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. Scattered trees and a small pond are present in the open field. The property has a rural layout with good overall access and visibility across the open land.
